name: The Tern crew's table
notes: mw-e40.30 (bible 4.5, 5.14). The high-stakes game at the Drowned Gull: dice against the Gilded Tern's bosun for a purse, first to 5. Win and the purse is yours; lose, and the cup you were handed was drugged and a shilling bought your name on Hesketh's articles (hesketh.shanghaied; src/game/shanghai wakes you in the Tern's hold, and hesketh-gilded-tern plays the scene). The ordinary Gull dice (drowned-gull-dice) never does this. PLACEHOLDER TUNING for the owner: fee, the bosun's pace (a round every 100 ticks, spread 1), the purse. The loaded die is the cheat; Nell watches the table.
